| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Focus center** `center` | 50 | 0 to 100 % | The height of the middle of the sharp band, from the top. |
| **Sharp band** `band` | 15 | 0 to 50 % | Half the height of the sharp band, as a share of the image height. |
| **Transition** `ramp` | 25 | 0 to 100 % | How far, as a share of the image height, the blur takes to reach its largest value. |
| **Largest blur** `maxBlur` | 6 | 0.5 to 30 px | The Gaussian sigma at the far ends. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
